blender-any.clarifying_question: What specific thing do you want to animate? (e.g. a character walking, a product showcase, a logo reveal)

todo.objective: A single-page web or mobile app that allows a user to create, view, check off, and delete todo items, with data persisted across sessions.

capabilities.reason: need a schema to store users, todos, and completion state
need authenticated endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting todos
need a UI that displays the todo list and sends changes to the API
need to reliably save and restore todo state across sessions

screws.objective: A mechanical dispenser that releases one screw at a time, counts each dispensed item, and updates an online inventory database tracking parts stock levels.

capabilities.reason: design the hopper and dispensing mechanism enclosure
mechanically dispense one screw at a time reliably from bulk
detect and count each dispensed screw using a sensor interrupt
run the dispenser motor and count logic on a microcontroller
send count updates from the device to the online database
design a database schema to track parts inventory and dispense events

rc-truck.clarifying_question: What specific RC truck project do you want to build — a custom chassis, a mod/upgrade, FPV setup, or something else?

knob.objective: Build a rotary input knob that provides programmable haptic detents and resistance feedback, similar to commercial products like the Surface Dial or haptic encoder modules.

capabilities.reason: design the knob housing and shaft assembly
track continuous rotary position for dynamic feedback calculations
drive the motor to create programmable resistance and detent forces at specific angles
implement the haptic feedback algorithms and state machine
design the driver board integrating encoder, motor driver, and microcontroller
route the board to fit inside the knob assembly
assemble the compact motor driver and encoder board

coaster.objective: A decorative PCB designed to function as a drink coaster, with traces and components arranged as art rather than for electronic function.

capabilities.reason: create a schematic even if it's decorative or non-functional
design the PCB artwork, traces, and silkscreen as the visual element
arrange traces, copper pours, and silkscreen intentionally for aesthetic effect
populate any decorative surface-mount LEDs or components if included

birds.objective: Create an illustration of birds lined up on a beach, drawn with proper perspective, composition, and gesture.

capabilities.reason: draw birds with believable anatomy and gesture, place them on a beach with working perspective and horizon line
understand bird structure, wing position, leg stance and proportions for multiple poses

printed.clarifying_question: What object do you want to 3D print?

apothecary.objective: Generate AI art depicting characters or scenes from The Apothecary Diaries in a consistent anime/light novel illustration style.

capabilities.reason: drive the model to match the specific anime/light novel aesthetic of the source material
keep characters like Maomao recognizable across multiple generated images
evaluate and guide composition, pose, and framing to match the source's visual storytelling

fishtank.objective: Create a Blender animation of a dish (plate/bowl of food) observing the scene from inside a fishtank in a Chinese restaurant setting

capabilities.reason: model the dish, fishtank, restaurant environment, and props
create materials for glass tank, water, ceramic/porcelain dish, and restaurant lighting
animate the dish character with believable timing and personality
simulate water caustics and possible fluid effects for underwater fishtank look
compose shots that establish the fishtank POV and restaurant context
composite render passes to achieve final underwater and lighting look

anime90s.objective: Create a 3D animation in Blender styled to look like 1990s anime, with cel-shaded characters and characteristic visual effects.

capabilities.reason: need to model characters and assets with anime-appropriate topology
need to rig characters for posing and animation
need to build the cel-shaded 90s anime look with proper edge detection and limited color ramps
need to animate with timing that matches 90s anime conventions (limited animation, pose-to-pose)
need to frame and move the camera to match anime cinematography
need to composite passes and add post effects like grain, chromatic aberration, or VHS artifacts

golf-mount.objective: A 3D printed clamp or bracket that attaches an iPhone securely to a golf bag at an angle suitable for recording golf swings.

capabilities.reason: model the mount body and any adjustment features
fit the clamp to the golf bag tube diameter and iPhone dimensions
choose a material that survives outdoor heat and UV without warping

gacha.objective: A mobile gacha game where players collect anime-style characters and play cooking-themed gameplay.

capabilities.reason: implement core game loop, scene flow, and cooking gameplay mechanics
design and implement character collection, drop rates, and progression
build touch-friendly UI for cooking gameplay and character management
generate consistent anime-style character art for the gacha roster
maintain visual consistency for each waifu character across expressions and poses
save player collection, currency, and progression
build and deploy the game as a mobile app

pokemon-bin.objective: Design and print a storage organizer for bulk Pokémon cards with compartments sorted by card type and color-coded for visual matching.

capabilities.reason: model compartmented storage that fits standard Pokémon card dimensions
design modular bins that snap together for expandable bulk storage
print compartments in different colors to match card types visually
choose filament colors and properties suitable for repeated card insertion and removal

gridfinity.objective: Create a Gridfinity-compatible organizer tray with custom cutouts shaped to fit specific tools (assuming hand tools like pliers, screwdrivers, or similar).

capabilities.reason: model the Gridfinity base unit and tray structure
trace and fit cutouts to the actual profile of each tool being organized
ensure the organizer locks into the Gridfinity baseplate correctly

ledger.objective: A mobile app that lets users track their stock portfolio holdings and values over time.

capabilities.reason: model holdings, transactions, and portfolio history with proper relationships
build backend API with user authentication to store portfolio data
build the iOS app interface for portfolio tracking
fetch real-time or delayed stock prices from a financial data API
allow users to view and edit portfolio data offline and sync when connected

dryer.objective: Build a wall-mounted or freestanding device that blows warm air to dry a person after showering, eliminating the need for towels.

capabilities.reason: design enclosure and airflow manifold for blower and heating element
size blower CFM and heating element wattage to actually dry a human body in reasonable time
safely wire mains-powered heating element in a bathroom environment
protect electrical components from constant steam and splashing in shower environment
control heating element duty cycle and blower speed with timer or sensor-based automation

verstappen.objective: Animate a race car (Max Verstappen's F1 car) running a race circuit in Blender.

capabilities.reason: model the F1 car and track environment
rig the car with working wheel rotation and suspension
animate the car movement with believable speed and weight
block camera angles that showcase the race action
create materials for the car livery and track surface
render and composite the final animation with motion blur

gundam.objective: Build a motorized Gundam-style robot head that detects a person in the room, tracks their movement, and rotates to follow them, with a transformation mechanism that changes the head's shape or configuration.

capabilities.reason: model the Gundam head shell and transformation parts
design the transformation linkage that changes head configuration without binding
detect person position in real time from camera feed
convert person detections into smooth pan-tilt servo targets
drive pan-tilt servos and transformation mechanism servos in sequence
coordinate vision, tracking logic, and servo sequencing on microcontroller
